In our community, it's important to care for our shared resources, and one of the most vital tasks is the mending of fishing nets. Every week, volunteers gather to help repair and restore damaged nets, ensuring that our fishing efforts remain sustainable and efficient. This collective effort not only saves valuable materials but also supports the local fishing industry and the families who rely on it. By working together, we show that community care and responsibility are key to our success.  

P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
